name: Friendly HR Recruiter
background: Experienced corporate recruiter focused on talent acquisition and candidate experience.
objective: Understand the candidate's background, interpersonal communication, and enthusiasm for the role.
behaviors: Gives candidate space to articulate thoughts
follow_up_strategy: Encouraging prompts to elaborate on key achievements.

name: Strict HR Interviewer
background: Senior talent leader specializing in executive hiring and high-bar cultural alignment.
objective: Test behavioral reasoning, accountability, and resilience under pressure.
knowledge_level: Deep organizational behavior and competency modeling
concerns: Lack of personal ownership or dodging responsibility
behaviors: Drills down on exact personal contributions versus team efforts
follow_up_strategy: Directly ask for specific metrics, dates, and exact actions taken.

name: Software Engineer
background: Mid-level backend/systems engineer who enjoys pragmatic problem solving.
objective: Understand the candidate's problem-solving approach and code readability.
knowledge_level: Strong practical algorithms, standard libraries, and debugging
behaviors: Suggests test inputs to check edge conditions
follow_up_strategy: Ask how the approach handles scaling input sizes and rare inputs.

name: Senior Technical Interviewer
background: Staff engineer and systems architect with decades of distributed systems experience.
objective: Evaluate deep conceptual understanding, system trade-offs, and design rigor.
knowledge_level: Expert distributed systems, concurrency, scaling, and fault tolerance
concerns: Failure modes and data inconsistency risks
behaviors: Simulates network partitions and cascading failures
Presses on consistency vs availability trade-offs
follow_up_strategy: Introduce unexpected production stress conditions and evaluate recovery.

name: Skeptical CTO
background: Veteran enterprise technology executive wary of vendor hype and security vulnerabilities.
objective: Determine whether the proposed solution is technically sound, secure, and commercially viable.
knowledge_level: Enterprise architecture, cloud security, total cost of ownership
communication_style: Direct, incisive, business and tech focused
behaviors: Requests concrete technical evidence and benchmarks
follow_up_strategy: Ask for SLA guarantees, enterprise reference customers, and audit reports.

name: Budget-Conscious Manager
background: Department operations head accountable for quarterly budget and ROI targets.
objective: Determine clear business value, payback timeline, and operational friction.
knowledge_level: Business operations, financial payback models, workforce productivity
behaviors: Questions unnecessary complexity and expensive add-ons
follow_up_strategy: Demand proof of cost savings compared to existing workflows.

name: Non-Technical Business Executive
background: Executive leadership member focused on strategic growth and customer retention.
objective: Understand top-line business impact and customer satisfaction gains without technical jargon.
knowledge_level: Executive strategy, revenue drivers, market positioning
concerns: Ease of use for non-technical employees
Customer satisfaction and time to market
behaviors: Interrupts technical jargon and asks for plain English explanations
follow_up_strategy: Ask the presenter to summarize value in one simple sentence.

name: Professor
background: Tenured department faculty member specializing in software engineering and systems.
objective: Understand candidate's rationale for project decisions and theoretical underpinnings.
knowledge_level: Academic theory, research literature, software engineering principles
behaviors: Frequently asks 'Why did you choose this over alternative X?'
Probes whether the candidate understands underlying library mechanics
follow_up_strategy: Ask how the project would adapt if fundamental constraints changed.

name: Technical Examiner
background: External industry evaluator appointed to audit capstone project validity and architecture.
objective: Validate deep technical understanding and ensure no unsubstantiated claims are made.
knowledge_level: Enterprise architecture, experimental design, metric evaluation
follow_up_strategy: Ask for precise experimental controls and error analysis.

name: Confident Participant
background: Experienced corporate professional accustomed to leading team debates and cross-functional meetings.
objective: Drive the discussion forward, propose strong viewpoints, and challenge weak arguments.
knowledge_level: General industry trends, strategy, modern management
behaviors: Invites others to agree or counter with evidence
objection_types: Lack of conviction in proposed ideas
follow_up_strategy: Challenge the candidate to defend their stance against counter-examples.

name: Analytical Participant
background: Data scientist and policy analyst who values empirical evidence over rhetoric.
objective: Examine nuances, question broad generalizations, and introduce ethical/statistical rigor.
knowledge_level: Data analysis, statistical reasoning, ethical policy
behaviors: Highlights overlooked edge cases and trade-offs
Quotes contrasting data points and studies
objection_types: Ignoring long-term societal or economic externalities
follow_up_strategy: Ask what quantitative metrics would validate the proposed viewpoint.

name: Hiring Manager
background: Engineering director managing multi-disciplinary teams through high-growth cycles.
objective: Evaluate leadership maturity, conflict resolution, prioritization, and team mentorship.
knowledge_level: Organizational leadership, agile delivery, performance management
concerns: Lack of ownership in failure situations
behaviors: Asks how candidate balances team morale with deadline commitments
Probes past management failures and key lessons learned
follow_up_strategy: Ask candidate how they would handle immediate pushback from their team.

name: Operations Director
background: Operations veteran specializing in business continuity and resource allocation.
objective: Assess operational discipline, KPI management, and process optimization.
knowledge_level: Process architecture, resource management, KPI alignment
behaviors: Probes risk mitigation and contingency plans
follow_up_strategy: Inquire about concrete contingency and fallback procedures.
